title: Tenant schema and search_path state causes GH-359-class failures
notes: Cluster C from the final integration run: TC-TNT-01-01, TC-TNT-01-03, TC-TNT-02-02, TC-TNT-03-01, TC-TNT-03-03, TC-TNT-03-05, and TC-DB-03-01 fail because a tenant table/schema is absent or a connection remains on search_path='public'. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6384-6503, 8713-8728, and 38774-38872. Follow-on/extension of GitHub #359. Originally registered 2026-08-01 (run_id WF03-gh364-20260801, handoff_id null) by the cluster-registration inner report. Re-associated with the dedicated WF03-gh377-20260804 run on 2026-08-04 (this handoff: dba38f9c-1881-4af3-b765-41fed454dfef). DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE 2026-08-04: Root cause is a routing bug in src/db/pool.zig::applyRequestStorageRouting (lines 173-208). The storage_mode resolver queries public.tenant.storage_mode for the current tenant_id; for freshly-provisioned tenants (random UUIDs created by integration tests) NO row exists in public.tenant, so the resolver falls through to the .LEGACY_RLS default branch and issues SET search_path TO public instead of SET search_path TO tenant_<uuid>,public. bpm_provision_tenant_schema() only inserts into public.tenant_schemas, NOT public.tenant — this is the asymmetry that causes the issue. Category: B (primary, integration/DB error in pool routing) + F (secondary, #359-era baseline drift amplifiers). Distinct from ISS-0112 (RESOLVED, schema_migrations ledger drift); ISS-0114 lives at the pool-routing layer. Diagnosis report: docs/issue-reports/ISS-0114-WF03-gh377-20260804.yaml. Resolution strategy: (1) make applyRequestStorageRouting treat absence-of-public.tenant-row + presence-of-tenant_schemas-row as SCHEMA mode; (2) make provisionTenantSchema insert public.tenant with storage_mode='SCHEMA' idempotently; (3) add a backfill migration for existing fixtures; (4) add regression tests per affected TC.
root_cause: storage_mode-resolver-falls-back-to-legacy-rls. Location: src/db/pool.zig::applyRequestStorageRouting (lines 173-208). When applying routing for a tenant_id, the resolver calls `SELECT storage_mode FROM public.tenant WHERE id = $1::uuid`. For tenants that were just provisioned via bpm_provision_tenant_schema() (which only inserts into public.tenant_schemas, NOT public.tenant), this query returns 0 rows. The fallback in the resolver then calls tenant_context_mod.setStorageMode(.LEGACY_RLS) unconditionally. The LEGACY_RLS branch then issues `SET search_path TO public` instead of `SET search_path TO tenant_<uuid>,public`. The threadlocal storage_mode cache is sticky across the test thread, so all subsequent pool.acquire() calls in the same thread inherit the wrong routing mode. Visible to tests as: search_path='public' (TC-TNT-02-02, TC-TNT-03-01, TC-TNT-03-03, TC-TNT-03-05), or C42P01 'relation does not exist' on unqualified business-table queries (TC-TNT-01-01, TC-TNT-01-03, TC-DB-03-01).
candidate_resolution: Three-layer fix: (a) make applyRequestStorageRouting treat absence-of-public.tenant-row + presence-of-tenant_schemas-row as SCHEMA mode (defensive fallback); (b) make provisionTenantSchema promote the tenant to public.tenant with storage_mode='SCHEMA' idempotently (authoritative path); (c) add a one-shot backfill migration for existing fixtures that have tenant_schemas rows but no public.tenant rows. Add regression tests for each affected TC. Also add explicit tenant_context.clear() in test makePool to reset the threadlocal storage_mode cache between tests.
prevention: Every freshly-provisioned tenant MUST have a row in public.tenant with storage_mode='SCHEMA' before pool.acquire() can be called for it.
applyRequestStorageRouting MUST NOT default to LEGACY_RLS when the tenant_schemas row exists.
Test fixtures must reset threadlocal thread_local state (tenant_context.clear()) between test cases to prevent sticky mode-cache contamination.
runForSchema should verify post-condition SHOW search_path before returning.
